data.name: Roulette Simulator 2027
data.detailed_description:
The most realistic roulette gambling simulation of all-time now has major new features, including Online Multiplayer.

Take your spot around the roulette table and interact with your friends as you play.  With public online ranked lobbies, you can work together to build your balance and earn Steam Achievements as you play.

Choose from a variety of characters as you play one of the most popular casino games in the entire world.  Roulette Simulator 2027 is the ultimate ONLINE roulette experience with an incredible focus on networking to bring this immersive roulette experience to multiplayer. 

For the first time ever in the Roulette Simulator series, you can play online with your friends.  Choose your character and spend hours playing together at the roulette wheel as you practice various betting strategies or simply play for entertainment.

Featuring all of your favorite real world roulette betting opportunities, including street bets and corner bets and an all new way to place your bets!  

Place your bets through a completely new command line system. Send bet commands and get immediate confirmation that your bet was placed. See your own bets alongside your friends as you play online and experience the thrilling game of roulette with them. Completely interact with the roulette environment with dozens of helpful commands that allow you to place your bets before each round begins.

NEW FEATURES

  • Online Multiplayer - Ranked Roulette Lobbies

  • Online Text Chat / Command Line Betting System

  • Ultimate HD Character Selection

  • Overhauled Roulette Physics Engine 

  • Steam Achievements

  • Steam Leaderboards

NEW CHARACTERS
